testimonials.quote: The high quality video was great to have, and most importantly it was so special to have grandparents who couldn't be there be able to watch our ceremony in real time!
For those of us unable to travel to the ceremony, the live stream provided the opportunity to share the experience and be moved by the occasion.

content.description_seo: Married Livestream is a Spokane, Washington-based wedding livestreaming, videography, and photography company founded in 2017. The team has covered more than 150 weddings across roughly 14 states, using 3-4 onsite cameras, dedicated microphones, and a combination of cellular bonding and Starlink connectivity to keep the stream running even at venues without reliable Wi-Fi. Guests watch through a private, link-only viewing page with no app or plug-in required, and couples can add extras like a digital guest book or virtual guest interviews. The company has been featured in outlets including USA Today, Budget Savvy Bride, and Bridal Musings.
content.one_line_summary: Spokane, WA-based livestream/film/photo company (est. 2017) with 150+ weddings across 14 states and a bonded-cellular/Starlink connectivity setup.

faq_items.a_summary: A private custom viewing page is created; an onsite producer switches between 3-4 cameras and integrates DJ or dedicated mics for audio.

faq_items.q: What if my venue doesn't have Wi-Fi?
faq_items.a_summary: Multi-carrier hotspots with cellular bonding are used, with Starlink available for very remote venues.

faq_items.q: Can random people watch my live stream?
faq_items.a_summary: No — the viewing page is private and shared only with people the couple gives the link to.
Yes, combining photo/video/livestream packages comes with a discount.

content.raw_about_text: INTERNAL ONLY: 'Our business began in 2017 with a simple idea: helping couples share their wedding day with their entire family, even those who couldn't be there in person. Seven years later, that vision has taken us to weddings in 14 different states and expanded into full photography and videography services.'
